name: Z
author: community
description: 121 real Yu-Gi-Oh! monsters the disc lacks, with fusions. Study project; art is Konami's.

cards.name: Luster Dragon
cards.description:
A very beautiful
dragon covered with
sapphire. It does
not like fights, but
has incredibly high
attack power.

cards.name: X-Head Cannon
cards.description:
A monster with a
mighty cannon
barrel, it is able
to integrate its
attacks.

cards.name: Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts
cards.description:
This monster moves
so fast that it
looks like an
illusion to mortal
eyes. (This card is
always treated as a
"Phantom Beast"
card.)

cards.name: Archfiend Soldier
cards.description:
An expert at battle
who belongs to a
crack diabolical
unit. He's famous
because he always
gets the job done.

cards.name: Mystical Shine Ball
cards.description:
A soul of light
covered by mystical
shine. When you see
its beautiful shape,
your dream will come
true.

cards.name: Hyozanryu
cards.description:
A dragon created
from a massive
diamond that
sparkles with
blinding light.

cards.name: Dark Blade
cards.description:
They say he is a
dragon-manipulating
warrior from the
dark world. His
attack is
tremendous, using
his great swords
with vicious power.

cards.name: Gagagigo
cards.description:
This young evildoer
used to have an evil
heart, but by
meeting a special
person, he
discovered justice.

cards.name: Thousand-Eyes Idol
cards.description:
A wicked entity that
controls the hearts
of men, its thousand
eyes are able to see
and expand the
negative influences
in an individual's
soul.

cards.name: Alpha The Magnet Warrior
cards.description:
Alpha, Beta, and
Gamma meld as one to
form a powerful
monster.

cards.name: Gogiga Gagagigo
cards.description:
His soul long-since
collapsed, his body
recklessly continues
onward, driven by a
lust for more power.
He no longer
resembles his former
self....

cards.name: Ryu-Ran
cards.description:
A vicious little
dragon sheltered in
an egg that looks
deceptively
harmless.

cards.name: Beta The Magnet Warrior
cards.description:
Alpha, Beta, and
Gamma meld as one to
form a powerful
monster.

cards.name: Gamma the Magnet Warrior
cards.description:
Alpha, Beta, and
Gamma meld as one to
form a powerful
monster.

cards.name: Humanoid Slime
cards.description:
This slime
apparently has some
human genes in its
genetic makeup.

cards.name: Ojama Black
cards.description:
He's one of the
Ojama Trio. It's
said that he butts
in by any means
necessary. It's also
said that when the
three are together,
something happens.

cards.name: Ojama Green
cards.description:
He's one of the
Ojama Trio. It's
said that he butts
in by any means
necessary. It's also
said that when the
three are together,
something happens.

cards.name: Mad Dog of Darkness
cards.description:
He used to be a
normal dog who
played around in a
park, but was
corrupted by the
powers of darkness.

cards.name: Wingweaver
cards.description:
A six-winged fairy
who prays for peace
and hope.

cards.name: Earthbound Spirit
cards.description:
A vengeful creature
formed by the
spirits of fallen
warriors, it drags
any who dare
approach it into the
deepest bowels of
the earth.

cards.name: Amphibian Beast
cards.description:
On land or in the
sea, the speed of
this monster is
unmatchable.

cards.name: Ojama Yellow
cards.description:
He's one of the
Ojama Trio. It's
said that he butts
in by any means
necessary. It's also
said that when the
three are together,
something happens.

cards.name: Melchid the Four-Face Beast
cards.description:
This monster has
four different masks
for four different
attacks.

cards.name: Sky Scout
cards.description:
With eyes like a
hawk and a flying
speed exceeding Mach
5, this monster is a
master of the sky.

cards.name: Slot Machine
cards.description:
The machine's
ability is said to
vary according to
its slot results.

cards.name: Headless Knight
cards.description:
A haunted spirit of
a falsely accused
knight who wanders
in search of truth
and justice.

cards.name: Twin-Headed Fire Dragon
cards.description:
Two dragons fused as
one from the effects
of the Big Bang.

cards.name: The Gross Ghost of Fled Dreams
cards.description:
This monster feeds
on the dreams of an
unwary sleeper,
dragging the victim
into eternal
slumber.

cards.name: Grand Tiki Elder
cards.description:
A masked monster
that wields the most
deadly of curses.

cards.name: The Earl of Demise
cards.description:
This gentlemanly
creature is
extremely wicked,
feared by man and
fiend alike.

cards.name: Shining Abyss
cards.description:
This monster employs
the powers of both
Light and Darkness.

cards.name: Red Archery Girl
cards.description:
A mermaid archer
that hides in a
protective shell,
waiting for the
right moment to
strike.

cards.name: Swordsman of Landstar
cards.description:
An amateur with a
sword, this fairy
warrior relies on
its mysterious
powers.

cards.name: Flying Kamakiri #2
cards.description:
A flying mantis that
feeds primarily on
insects.

cards.name: Worm Drake
cards.description:
Once this monster
wraps itself around
a victim, there is
no escape.

cards.name: Luster Dragon #2
cards.description:
This dragon feeds on
emerald. Enchanted
by this monster even
when attacked, few
people live to tell
of its beauty.

cards.name: Giga Gagagigo
cards.description:
In order to fight
tremendous evil, he
gained formidable
power through body
reconstruction, but
lost his heart and
his redemption.

cards.name: Gadget Soldier
cards.description:
A rust-free machine
warrior born to
battle.

cards.name: Opticlops
cards.description:
A one-eyed giant
that serves the
"Dark Ruler Ha Des",
it skewers its
enemies with its
sharp horn,
shattering them to
pieces.

cards.name: The Portrait's Secret
cards.description:
A portrait cursed by
the artist, it is
said to bring ill
fortune to anyone
who owns it.

cards.name: Great Angus
cards.description:
A very violent
beast, it is always
berserk. People say
that they have never
seen it silent.

cards.name: Darkfire Soldier #1
cards.description:
An explosive expert
from a special elite
force.

cards.name: Gradius
cards.description:
A high-performance
jet fighter with
power capsules for
variable attack
capabilities.

cards.name: Warrior Dai Grepher
cards.description:
The warrior who can
manipulate dragons.
Nobody knows his
mysterious past.

cards.name: Girochin Kuwagata
cards.description:
Despite its small
size, this monster
has powerful jaws
that can rip metal
to shreds.

cards.name: Souls of the Forgotten
cards.description:
A wicked spirit
created by the
hateful souls of
those who fell in
battle. It grows by
assimilating the
souls of its
enemies.

cards.name: Island Turtle
cards.description:
A huge turtle that
is often mistaken
for an island.

cards.name: The Dragon Dwelling in the Cave
cards.description:
A huge dragon
dwelling in a cave.
It is horrible when
it gets angry,
although it is
usually quiet. It is
said to preserve
certain treasures.

cards.name: Three-Headed Geedo
cards.description:
A three-headed
nocturnal monster
that is absolutely
ruthless when
fighting.

cards.name: Overdrive
cards.description:
An all-terrain
armored vehicle
armed with a heavy-
duty machine gun.

cards.name: Darkfire Soldier #2
cards.description:
A warrior who gained
immeasurable power
from the heart of a
volcano.

cards.name: Mokey Mokey
cards.description:
An outcast angel.
Nobody knows what he
is thinking at all.
Sometimes he gets
mad and that is
dreadful.

cards.name: Kabazauls
cards.description:
A huge monster in
the shape of a
hippopotamus. The
sneezing from his
gigantic body is so
fierce that people
mistake it for a
hurricane.

cards.name: Garnecia Elefantis
cards.description:
A monster so heavy
that each step rocks
the earth.

cards.name: Charcoal Inpachi
cards.description:
A wicked wooden
spirit that has
burned out. The
barbecue grilled
with this charcoal
is so awesome that
everybody thinks
it's priceless.

cards.name: Big Koala
cards.description:
A species of huge
Des Koala. He's
meek, but people are
afraid of him
because he's very
powerful.

cards.name: Skull Mariner
cards.description:
A pirate ship that
appears out of the
mist and sinks any
seagoing vessels.

cards.name: Terrorking Salmon
cards.description:
A feared salmon,
master of the Sea of
Darkness. Its roe is
the best delicacy in
the World of
Darkness.

cards.name: Blazing Inpachi
cards.description:
A wicked wooden
spirit now burning
in flames. Its fire
attack is powerful,
but it will soon be
nothing but ashes.

cards.name: Spikebot
cards.description:
A mechanical soldier
created by a wicked
sorcerer, it attacks
with the two steel
balls attached to
its arms.

cards.name: Mr. Volcano
cards.description:
This seemingly mild-
mannered creature
has an extremely
volatile temper.

cards.name: Metal Armored Bug
cards.description:
A gigantic insect-
like creature
covered by thick
armor. Everything in
his path is
destroyed.

cards.name: Robotic Knight
cards.description:
The Commander of
Machine-Types, he
serves the Machine
King. He is famous
for the way he
controls his troops.

cards.name: Oni Tank T-34
cards.description:
An armored tank
possessed by a fiend
that will pursue
enemies until
they're crushed.

cards.name: Steel Ogre Grotto #2
cards.description:
A mechanized iron
doll with tremendous
strength.

cards.name: Neo Bug
cards.description:
A huge bug-like
monster said to come
from another planet.
It gathers in
swarms.

cards.name: Flying Fish
cards.description:
Three wishes are
granted to those
fortunate enough to
see this monster in
flight.

cards.name: Neo the Magic Swordsman
cards.description:
A dimensional
drifter who not only
practices sorcery,
but is also a sword
and martial arts
master.

cards.name: Sea Serpent Warrior of Darkness
cards.description:
A warrior who
defends the world of
the Sea of Darkness.
He prides himself on
his fighting prowess
both on the ground
and, of course, in
the water.

cards.name: Cyber Falcon
cards.description:
A jet-powered hawk
that travels at the
speed of sound.

cards.name: Master Kyonshee
cards.description:
A wandering Kyonshee
searching for a
strong rival to
defeat. They say he
was known as the
master of all
martial arts.

cards.name: Oppressed People
cards.description:
They are oppressed,
but believe they
will have their
freedom someday.

cards.name: Flame Champion
cards.description:
A warrior protected
by a flaming shield
that nullifies any
attack.

cards.name: Empress Mantis
cards.description:
Queen of an army of
giant mantises whose
command moves
legions.

cards.name: Aitsu
cards.description:
He seems to be very
unreliable, but he
might have
incredible
potential.

cards.name: Beast of Talwar
cards.description:
Only the master of
the sword among
Fiend-Type monsters
is permitted to hold
the Talwar. (This
card is always
treated as an
"Archfiend" card.)

cards.name: D.D. Trainer
cards.description:
A poor goblin that
was sucked into a
different dimension.
However, he's doing
his best with his
new destiny.

cards.name: Dokuroyaiba
cards.description:
A boomerang with
brains that will
pursue a target to
the ends of the
earth.

cards.name: Inpachi
cards.description:
A log that attacks
lost travelers in
the forest.
Originally a big
tree, it was cut
down and possessed
by a wicked spirit.

cards.name: Harpie Girl
cards.description:
A Harpie chick who
aspires to flit
about beautifully
and gorgeously, but
attack sharply.

cards.name: Battle Footballer
cards.description:
A cyborg with high
defense power.
Originally it was
invented for a
football machine.

cards.name: The All-Seeing White Tiger
cards.description:
A proud ruler of the
jungle that some
fear and others
respect.

cards.name: The Illusory Gentleman
cards.description:
Wearing odd
fashions, this
gentleman is very
fickle. He sometimes
saves people and at
other times commits
crimes.

cards.name: Neo Aqua Madoor
cards.description:
The true nature of
this wizard, who
rules all water. It
defends itself with
a vast, impenetrable
wall of ice.

cards.name: Soul Tiger
cards.description:
The soul of a tiger
that is said to
devour human souls.
He is a famous soul
that you wouldn't
want to run into in
a dark alley.

cards.name: Wolf Axwielder
cards.description:
Once it has started
battle, this monster
attacks fiercely and
cannot stop.

cards.name: Bio-Mage
cards.description:
A mysterious priest
created as a result
of the latest
advances in
biotechnology.

cards.name: Robolady
cards.description:
A warrior fully
covered with metal.
It upgrades by
fusing with
"Roboyarou".

cards.name: Warrior of Zera
cards.description:
A wandering warrior
who seeks the
sanctuary where he
can gain the power
of the Archlords.

cards.name: Lizard Soldier
cards.description:
A beast soldier
derived from
dragons, it is small
for a Dragon-Type.
Moving very quickly,
this monster is an
excellent
strategist.

cards.name: Sonic Duck
cards.description:
A duck which can
walk at a sonic
speed. Sometimes, he
cannot deal with his
incredible pace and
loses control.

cards.name: Roboyarou
cards.description:
A warrior fully
covered with metal.
It upgrades by
fusing with
"Robolady".

cards.name: Science Soldier
cards.description:
Soldiers equipped
with state-of-the-
art weaponry to face
unknown creatures.

cards.name: Dark Bat
cards.description:
Bats from the
netherworld that use
their hyper senses
to detect their
enemies.

cards.name: Acrobat Monkey
cards.description:
An autonomous monkey
type robot which was
developed with
cutting-edge
technology. It moves
very acrobatically.

cards.name: Pharaoh's Servant
cards.description:
An apparition of
those said to
formerly serve the
Pharaoh. It has
tremendous loyalty
that does not
waiver.

cards.name: People Running About
cards.description:
Although they always
suffer in silence,
they swear an oath
to inevitably
revolt.

cards.name: Shapesnatch
cards.description:
A bow tie with
horrible power, it
attacks an opponent
by controlling
others.

cards.name: United Resistance
cards.description:
The people that
gather to swear to
fight their
oppressors. A
revolution is
coming.

cards.name: Boneheimer
cards.description:
This monster wanders
the seas, sucking
dry any creatures it
may encounter.

cards.name: Cyber Dragon
cards.description:
A mechanical dragon
built for battle.
Fused with its own
kind, it grows a
second head, then a
third.

cards.name: Cyber Twin Dragon
cards.description:
Two Cyber Dragons
joined into one. Its
twin heads fire one
blast after another.

cards.name: Cyber End Dragon
cards.description:
A three-headed
machine dragon of
ultimate power. Its
triple blast pierces
any defense.

cards.name: Raviel, Lord of Phantasms
cards.description:
The phantasm lord
who rules over the
demons. Its roar
shakes the sky and
drains the will of
its foes.

cards.name: Arcana Knight Joker
cards.description:
The ace knight born
when the King, Queen
and Jack unite. It
wields the power of
every suit.

cards.name: Valkyrion the Magna Warrior
cards.description:
The three Magnet
Warriors joined into
one. Magnetic force
binds its body into
an unbreakable
shield.

cards.name: Ancient Gear Megaton Golem
cards.description:
An ancient war
machine rebuilt from
countless gears.
Each step it takes
shakes the earth.

cards.name: Super Conductor Tyranno
cards.description:
A dinosaur charged
with lightning. Its
bite carries a
deadly electric
shock.

cards.name: Thunder Dragon Titan
cards.description:
The final form of
the thunder dragons.
Its body is a storm,
and every roar calls
down lightning.

cards.name: Gladiator Beast Heraklinos
cards.description:
The champion of the
gladiator beasts. It
rules the arena with
a mighty spear and
blazing flames.

cards.name: Volcanic Doomfire
cards.description:
A fiend born from
the heart of a
volcano. Its molten
body burns all that
stand before it.

cards.name: Vampire Genesis
cards.description:
The first vampire,
reborn from the
Vampire Lord. It
commands the undead
from its coffin
throne.

cards.name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8
cards.description:
The black flame
dragon in its final
form. Its dark fire
can silence any
spell.

cards.name: VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon
cards.description:
Five combat machines
united into one
flying fortress. Its
catapult cannon
blasts any target
away.

cards.name: Dark Paladin
cards.description:
The dark knight born
when a spellcaster
and a dragon-slayer
join forces. Its
sword drains the
strength of dragons.

cards.name: Spiral Serpent
cards.description:
A giant serpent that
coils around the
sea. It wraps its
prey in its spiral
body.

cards.name: Simorgh, Bird of Ancestry
cards.description:
A sacred bird of
legend that rules
the sky. Its wings
call down a storm.

cards.name: Tytannial, Princess of Camellias
cards.description:
The princess of the
camellia garden. Her
blossoms bloom into
a storm of petals.

cards.name: Cloudian - Eye of the Typhoon
cards.description:
The king of the
clouds. It sits in
the eye of a typhoon
and rules the storm.

cards.name: Beast King Barbaros
cards.description:
The king of all
beasts. Its roar
alone puts a whole
army to flight.

cards.name: Ultimate Flame Swordsman
cards.description:
The flame swordsman
at its peak, burning
with more fire than
ever. Its blade cuts
through anything.
